    type = location_event
    orphan = yes
    title = empty_text
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        culture:oe_armenian_greek_culture = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_armenia_two_start_timer } }
                every_movement_in_culture = {
                    limit = { movement_type = movement_definition:oe_armenian_identity_movement }
                    destroy_movement = yes
                }
                remove_variable = oe_identity_fixed_30y_scheduled
                remove_variable = oe_identity_start_verified
                set_variable = { name = oe_identity_wave_cd years = 10 }
            }
        }
    }
}
